summary: Swati (6°40'-20°00' Libra, ruled by Rahu, deity Vayu the wind) gives a gentle, courteous, self-reliant and trade-minded nature that bends with circumstances and grows strong slowly.
common_outcomes: gentle, kind and pleasant in speech (BJ 16.8; HS 28.15)
self-controlled and principled, often a merchant or in trade (BJ 16.8)
compassionate and inclined to dharma (BJ 16.8; HS 28.15)
lives or works away from home; may run into debts (HS 28.15)
diplomatic, social, avoids taking sides; can procrastinate (Trivedi)
rare_outcomes: strained relations with relatives and few sons (HS 28.15)
devoted to gods and Brahmins and fond of enjoyment, wealthy but of modest intelligence (JP 9.87)
great commercial wealth when the Moon here rules the 11th (Trivedi's example)

by_area.personality: Mild, courteous, self-controlled and compassionate (BJ, HS); Trivedi adds a strong need for balance and harmony that can turn into indecision and following the crowd.
by_area.career: Trade and business are the classic fit (BJ 16.8 'merchant'); Trivedi lists business, law, diplomacy, aviation, transport, teaching and technology.
by_area.finance: Wealth is promised by Jataka Parijata (9.87) and Trivedi calls it the best nakshatra for business; Hora Sara (28.15) warns of debts.
by_area.relationships: Pleasant and sociable (all sources); Hora Sara notes friction with one's own relatives.
by_area.spirituality: Linked by Trivedi to Saraswati and learning; Jataka Parijata has the native please gods and Brahmins.

strengtheners: the birth star aspected by or joined with benefics gives its good results fully (HS 28.28, general rule for any birth star)
Rahu, Mercury, Venus and Saturn give strong results here (Trivedi)
Mercury linked to Swati brings out its learning side (Trivedi)
weakeners_or_cancellations: the Sun and Mars are uneasy here and Ketu is incompatible with it (Trivedi)
lower expression: indulgence, greed, people-pleasing (Trivedi)
lagna_or_context_notes: Trivedi: those with prominent Swati tend to bloom late, with a stronger second half of life.

attributes.deity: Vayu, the wind god (BS 98.4-5; Raman Muhurta; PVR; Trivedi)
attributes.symbol: a young plant shoot blown by the wind; also coral and a sword (Trivedi). Raman (HPA) describes the star (Arcturus) as a single star resembling a sapphire.
attributes.yoni: buffalo, male (Raman Muhurta); Trivedi also gives buffalo
attributes.nature: chara (movable) (BS 98.11; Raman Muhurta). Trivedi: passive, rajasic, level-facing, Deva, female, butcher caste.
attributes.sign_span: 6°40'-20°00' Libra; all 4 padas in Libra (Frawley; Raman HPA; PVR)

as_moon: Varahamihira (BJ 16.8): gentle and self-controlled, a principled trader, compassionate, sweet-spoken and devoted to dharma. Hora Sara (28.15): mild, happy, kind, courteous and virtuous, but runs into debts, lives away from home, is at odds with relatives, dresses simply and has few sons. Jataka Parijata (9.87): pleases gods and Brahmins, enjoys life and has much wealth but limited intelligence. Trivedi: the keyword is balance; diplomatic, sociable, adaptable and good at long-term planning, but prone to indecision and to following the crowd.
as_lagna: Trivedi: Swati natives are usually slim and well proportioned, often seen wearing a fixed smile in groups; his example is Mark Twain (lagna, Mercury and Saturn in Swati), where the intellectual side shows.
planets_in_it: Saturn reaches its highest exaltation in Swati and the Sun its deepest debilitation (Trivedi, ch. 15)
Venus in the lagna and in Swati (or Krittika, Revati, Pushya, Ashwini) makes one a ruler (Saravali 35.148)
Rahu, Mercury, Venus and Saturn give strong results; the Sun and Mars are uneasy; Ketu does not suit it; Jupiter and the Moon are neutral (Trivedi)

padas.1: 6°40'-10°00' Libra, Sagittarius navamsha (Jupiter): restless and curious; writing, communication, travel; most planets do reasonably well (Trivedi).
padas.2: 10°00'-13°20' Libra, Capricorn navamsha (Saturn): most grounded pada; focus on material growth and comfort; good business sense (Trivedi).
padas.3: 13°20'-16°40' Libra, Aquarius navamsha (Saturn): most intellectual pada; learning and group work; Mercury, Venus and Saturn strong (Trivedi).
padas.4: 16°40'-20°00' Libra, Pisces navamsha (Jupiter): most adaptable; a Pushkara navamsha; success through hard work and sociability; all planets except Mercury do well (Trivedi).

source_views.source: Prash Trivedi, The Book of Nakshatras, ch. 15 (Swati)
source_views.view: Balance is the keyword; diplomatic, sociable, adaptable, slow to bloom; Rajasic, Deva, passive, movable; buffalo yoni; best nakshatra for business; pada notes; Saturn exalted and Sun debilitated here.

disagreements: Hora Sara alone stresses debts, friction with relatives and few sons, while Jataka Parijata promises much wealth (but little intelligence) and Brihat Jataka gives only positive traits. Trivedi gives the element as fire although Swati is ruled by Rahu and linked to the wind.
phrasing_guidance: Describe tendencies, not fixed fate; the nakshatra is one factor among many (sign, house, aspects, dasha). Classical one-line Moon-nakshatra results are short lists of traits: present the positive ones as potentials and the negative ones as things to watch. Never state death, harm to relatives, or disease as a prediction. Lead with courtesy, independence and a head for trade; mention debts and indecision as tendencies to manage.

summary: Vishakha (20°00' Libra-3°20' Scorpio, ruled by Jupiter, deities Indra and Agni) gives single-minded drive towards a goal, eloquence and ambition, with a pull towards envy and quarrels.
common_outcomes: eloquent and dignified, but envious and greedy (BJ 16.9)
inclined to quarrels or to stir them up (BJ 16.9)
talks a lot, has wife, children, money and learning, respects teachers and is generous (HS 28.16)
proud but devoted to the spouse, overcomes enemies, irritable (JP 9.87)
fixated on goals; restless after each achievement (Trivedi)
rare_outcomes: eye trouble (HS 28.16)
skill at making money (Trivedi quoting Varahamihira)

by_area.personality: Eloquent and driven, but envious and argumentative (BJ, HS, JP); Trivedi's keyword is 'fixation': unmatched single-mindedness, with the risk of choosing unwholesome goals.
by_area.career: Trivedi lists politics, broadcasting, sport, military and police work, and the liquor trade, and notes frequent career changes.
by_area.finance: Good at earning (Trivedi quoting Varahamihira); Hora Sara gives wealth.
by_area.relationships: Devoted to the spouse (JP 9.87); Trivedi links it to marriage symbolism (the decorated gateway) and to intense, longing love.
by_area.spirituality: Respects the learned and Brahmins (HS); Trivedi sees the frustration that follows success turning some natives towards higher knowledge and penance.

strengtheners: Jupiter is the planet that does well here (Trivedi)
the Sun, Moon and Jupiter bring out its sattvic, hardworking side (Trivedi)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Venus-Jupiter tension in the Libra padas makes it turbulent (Trivedi)
pada 4 (Scorpio) is volatile and revengeful in its lower expression (Trivedi)

attributes.deity: Indragni, Indra and Agni together (BS 98.4-5; Raman Muhurta; Trivedi); PVR's table shows Indra
attributes.symbol: a decorated arch or gateway (Trivedi); Raman (HPA): three stars resembling a potter's wheel
attributes.yoni: tiger, male (Raman Muhurta); Trivedi also gives tiger
attributes.nature: mishra (mixed, soft-and-sharp) (BS 98.11; Raman Muhurta; Trivedi). Trivedi: active, sattvic, downward-facing, female, outcaste (mleccha).
attributes.sign_span: 20°00' Libra-3°20' Scorpio; padas 1-3 in Libra, pada 4 in Scorpio

as_moon: Varahamihira (BJ 16.9): envious and greedy, yet dignified and clever with words, and given to starting quarrels. Hora Sara (28.16): jealous, very talkative, with sons, wife, wealth and learning, respectful to the learned and generous, but prone to eye disease. Jataka Parijata (9.87): proud yet devoted to the wife, overcomes enemies, easily irritated. Trivedi: obsessive pursuit of goals, followed by emptiness after each success; capable of great effort and penance when the goal is worthy.
as_lagna: Trivedi: a fierce look with sharp features and angles to the face; manners range from very courteous to obnoxious; tends to hide negative feelings behind a front. His lagna example is Nicole Kidman.
planets_in_it: only Jupiter functions well here in the present age, in the author's experience (Trivedi)
Venus or Mars suit pada 1; Mercury and Saturn suit pada 3; only Jupiter steadies pada 4 (Trivedi)

padas.1: 20°00'-23°20' Libra, Aries navamsha (Mars): energy, impulse, social ambition; passion over commitment (Trivedi).
padas.2: 23°20'-26°40' Libra, Taurus navamsha (Venus): endurance; material ambitions fulfilled; a Pushkara navamsha (Trivedi).
padas.3: 26°40'-30°00' Libra, Gemini navamsha (Mercury): drive turned to thought and belief; inner conflict between openness and anxiety (Trivedi).
padas.4: 0°00'-3°20' Scorpio, Cancer navamsha (Moon): most one-pointed and emotionally volatile pada; can be revengeful, or give penetrating insight and will (Trivedi).

source_views.view: Keyword 'fixation'; goal-driven, prone to envy, excess and emptiness after success; Rakshasa, sattvic, mixed, active; tiger yoni; pada notes; only Jupiter works well here.

disagreements: Deity: Brihat Samhita and Raman give the pair Indra-Agni (Indragni); PVR's table lists only Indra. Hora Sara and Jataka Parijata stress family and marital devotion, while Brihat Jataka gives only temperament (envy, eloquence, quarrels). Trivedi calls it sattvic despite its Rakshasa gana.
phrasing_guidance: Describe tendencies, not fixed fate; the nakshatra is one factor among many (sign, house, aspects, dasha). Classical one-line Moon-nakshatra results are short lists of traits: present the positive ones as potentials and the negative ones as things to watch. Never state death, harm to relatives, or disease as a prediction. Frame envy and quarrelsomeness as the shadow of strong ambition; emphasise focus, persistence and eloquence.

summary: Anuradha (3°20'-16°40' Scorpio, ruled by Saturn, deity Mitra) gives friendliness, devotion, organising ability and a life of travel or residence abroad, with a strong appetite.
common_outcomes: prosperous; lives abroad and travels (BJ 16.9; HS 28.17)
cannot bear hunger; strong appetite (BJ 16.9; HS 28.17)
kind, virtuous and fortunate (HS 28.17)
able, easy-going, honourable, famous and powerful (JP 9.88, partly legible)
a bridge between people; founder or leader of groups (Trivedi)
rare_outcomes: grief or sorrow (HS 28.17)
interest in occult subjects and numbers (Trivedi)

by_area.personality: Friendly and devoted but emotionally sensitive behind a tough exterior (Trivedi); kind and virtuous (HS).
by_area.career: Trivedi: organisers and heads of institutions, scientists, statisticians, astrologers, and work involving foreign countries.
by_area.relationships: Trivedi: friendly and good at putting people at ease, but in the present age prone to too many shallow friendships.
by_area.spirituality: Channels emotion into devotion (Trivedi; 'power of worship').

strengtheners: all planets can work well here, depending on the chart (Trivedi)
Mars in Anuradha, if vargottama or exalted, forms a raja yoga (Saravali 35.164)
weakeners_or_cancellations: pada 3 carries some self-undoing and wastefulness (Trivedi)
lagna_or_context_notes: Trivedi: living in foreign lands is usually satisfying and fruitful for Anuradha natives.

attributes.symbol: a staff, also a lotus (Trivedi); Raman (HPA): three stars resembling an umbrella
attributes.yoni: hare, female (Raman Muhurta); Trivedi gives deer
attributes.nature: mridu (soft) (BS 98.10; Raman Muhurta; Trivedi). Trivedi: passive, tamasic, level, male, shudra caste.

as_moon: Varahamihira (BJ 16.9): prosperous, living abroad, a wanderer who cannot bear hunger. Hora Sara (28.17): troubled by hunger and thirst, given to grief, yet kind, virtuous and fortunate; wanders and lives abroad. Jataka Parijata (9.88, OCR partly legible): able, ease-loving, honourable, famous and powerful. Trivedi: an explorer who works through people, combining friendliness with reserve; devoted, organised, drawn to travel and the occult.
as_lagna: Trivedi: a stout, often hairy body with a prominent chest and thighs and a belly with age; a friendly face with a hint of secrecy in the eyes. His lagna example is Jim Morrison.
planets_in_it: Mars in Anuradha (or Ashwini, Dhanishta) gives a raja yoga only if Mars is also vargottama or exalted (Saravali 35.164)
Mars-Saturn conjunctions or mutual aspects carry Anuradha's energy (Trivedi)
the Sun, Mars, Jupiter and Ketu are strong in pada 1; Mercury and Rahu in pada 2; Venus and Saturn in pada 3; the Sun, Jupiter and Ketu in pada 4 (Trivedi)

padas.1: 3°20'-6°40' Scorpio, Leo navamsha (Sun): self-understanding applied to career; curb pride or militancy (Trivedi).
padas.2: 6°40'-10°00' Scorpio, Virgo navamsha (Mercury): learning, discipline, numbers and organisation; a Pushkara navamsha (Trivedi).
padas.3: 10°00'-13°20' Scorpio, Libra navamsha (Venus): arts, music, the occult; sociable, some wastefulness (Trivedi).
padas.4: 13°20'-16°40' Scorpio, Scorpio navamsha (Mars): abundant energy; the task is channelling passion constructively (Trivedi).

Never state death, harm to relatives, or disease as a prediction. Emphasise friendship, devotion and success abroad; mention appetite lightly.

summary: Jyeshtha (16°40'-30°00' Scorpio, ruled by Mercury, deity Indra) gives seniority, a protective and responsible streak, contentment with few friends, and a quick temper; its end meets Mula at a gandanta junction.
common_outcomes: few friends, contented, virtuous, quick to anger (BJ 16.10)
satisfied, virtuous, many sons and friends, angry, troubled by relatives, prominent in the family (HS 28.18)
cares about image and respect; protective of the weak (Trivedi)
rare_outcomes: drawn to women not his own (JP 9.88, partly legible)
lustful (Trivedi quoting Varahamihira)
vindictiveness and jealousy in its lower expression (Trivedi)

by_area.personality: Contented and virtuous but quick-tempered (BJ, HS); Trivedi: concerned with image and standing, protective, responsible, but prone to exaggerating troubles and to jealousy.
by_area.career: Trivedi: police, military, administration, government, broadcasting and other authority or protective roles.
by_area.finance: Trivedi: pada 1 swings between financial extremes; the poverty side is reduced in pada 4.
by_area.family: Many sons; prominent among one's own family but troubled by relatives (HS 28.18). See padas for the classical warnings about relatives.
by_area.spirituality: Trivedi: penance is needed for Jyeshtha to work well.

strengtheners: only a well-placed Mercury gives good results here (Trivedi)
Jupiter gives the best results in pada 1 (Trivedi)
weakeners_or_cancellations: most planets here need watching as they tend to disturb peace of mind (Trivedi)
birth in the gandanta portion at its end (junction with Mula) is held to be inauspicious (JP 9.45; Hora Sara 1.14; Saravali 3.20-21)
lagna_or_context_notes: Gandanta: the last part of Jyeshtha joins the first part of Mula. Jataka Parijata 9.45 gives the junction as a span of ghatikas; Hora Sara 1.14 gives one ghatika at the junction (some say the evil runs 4 or 6 years); Saravali 3.20-21 names the end of Scorpio.

attributes.symbol: a round talisman or earring (Trivedi); Raman (HPA): three stars (Antares) resembling an umbrella
attributes.yoni: hare, male (Raman Muhurta); Trivedi gives stag
attributes.nature: tikshna (sharp, dreadful) (BS 98.7; Raman Muhurta; Trivedi). Trivedi: active, sattvic, level, female, servant caste.
attributes.sign_span: 16°40'-30°00' Scorpio; all 4 padas in Scorpio; ends at the Scorpio-Sagittarius gandanta

as_moon: Varahamihira (BJ 16.10): few friends, contented, virtuous and quick to anger. Hora Sara (28.18): satisfied and virtuous with many sons and friends, very angry, troubled by relatives, and a leading figure in the family. Jataka Parijata (9.88, OCR largely illegible): the legible words link Jyeshtha with desire for women not one's own. Trivedi: image-conscious, protective of the weak and responsible, but liable to magnify troubles, to jealousy and to a wish to 'get even'.
as_lagna: Trivedi: matures early in body and mind and does not keep youth long; well proportioned with a stronger upper body; penetrating, probing eyes.
planets_in_it: only a well-placed Mercury gives good results; most planets here tend to work against peace of mind (Trivedi)
Mercury-Mars and Mercury-Mars-Ketu conjunctions carry Jyeshtha's energy (Trivedi)
Mars does poorly in pada 4; Venus and Jupiter there raise material gain (Trivedi)

padas.1: 16°40'-20°00' Scorpio, Sagittarius navamsha (Jupiter): family and money concerns, generous, a risk-taker; Jupiter best; planets here are said to harm siblings' wellbeing (Trivedi). Jataka Parijata 9.50: birth in the 1st quarter endangers the eldest brother [maraka: text predicts danger to life / death].
padas.2: 20°00'-23°20' Scorpio, Capricorn navamsha (Saturn): rigid, authoritative, late achievement; affects younger siblings (Trivedi). JP 9.50: 2nd quarter endangers an elder brother [maraka: text predicts danger to life / death].
padas.3: 23°20'-26°40' Scorpio, Aquarius navamsha (Saturn): humanitarian, protective of the underprivileged; said to affect the mother (Trivedi). JP 9.50: 3rd quarter endangers the father [maraka: text predicts danger to life / death].
padas.4: 26°40'-30°00' Scorpio, Pisces navamsha (Jupiter): very emotional, risk of indulgence; devotion at best; most self-destructive in its negative form (Trivedi). JP 9.50: 4th quarter endangers the native [maraka: text predicts danger to life / death]. This pada ends at the Jyeshtha-Mula gandanta.
padas.tenths: JP 9.46-48 divide Jyeshtha's duration into ten parts, each said to endanger a different relative (maternal grandparents, maternal uncle, mother, the child, cattle and wealth, both families, the whole line, father-in-law, everything) [maraka: text predicts danger to life / death].

source_views.view: Born in Jyeshtha: satisfied, virtuous, many sons and friends, very angry, troubled by relatives, foremost in his family.

source_views.source: Jataka Parijata 9.88 (Vaidyanatha, tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri, 1932) (OCR largely illegible)
source_views.view: Legible fragment links Jyeshtha with women not one's own.

source_views.source: Jataka Parijata 9.45-50, 59, 64-67 (Vaidyanatha, tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri, 1932)
source_views.view: 45: gandanta at the Jyeshtha-Mula, Ashlesha-Magha and Revati-Ashwini junctions is harmful; the ghatika at the Jyeshtha-Mula junction is Abhukta-mula and birth then ruins the family [maraka: text predicts danger to life / death]. 46-48: tenths of Jyeshtha each endanger a relative. 49: a girl born in Jyeshtha on a Tuesday endangers her eldest brother. 50: quarters 1-4 endanger the eldest brother, an elder brother, the father, the native [maraka: text predicts danger to life / death]. 59: ganda at the end of Jyeshtha operates at night. 64-67: the period of risk for Jyeshtha is one year.

source_views.source: Hora Sara 1.14 (tr. R. Santhanam)
source_views.view: One ghatika at each of the Revati-Ashwini, Ashlesha-Magha and Jyeshtha-Mula junctions is gandanta; its evil lasts four years (some say six).

source_views.source: Hora Sara 28.29 (tr. R. Santhanam)
source_views.view: A girl born in Jyeshtha (with Ardra, Ashlesha, Shatabhisha, Pushya, Mula, Chitra, Krittika) should be avoided in marriage, as she brings grief, death, consumption or quarrels to relatives [maraka: text predicts danger to life / death].

source_views.source: Saravali 3.20-21 (English tr. as uploaded)
source_views.view: The ends of Cancer, Scorpio and Pisces are gandanta; one born then may not survive, may lose the mother or end the line, but if he survives becomes a king [maraka: text predicts danger to life / death].

source_views.source: Prash Trivedi, The Book of Nakshatras, ch. 18 (Jyeshtha)
source_views.view: A sense of arriving; image-conscious, protective, responsible, temper and jealousy; Rakshasa, sattvic, sharp, active; stag yoni; pada notes with effects on siblings and mother; only a well-placed Mercury does well.

disagreements: Friends: Brihat Jataka says few friends; Hora Sara says many sons and friends. Yoni: hare (Raman) versus stag (Trivedi). Pada effects on relatives: Jataka Parijata 9.50 assigns the 3rd quarter to the father, Trivedi assigns pada 3 to the mother. Gandanta extent: one ghatika (Hora Sara 1.14), a span of ghatikas (JP 9.45), or simply the end of the sign (Saravali); Santhanam's note on Hora Sara cites Lagnachandrika's last five ghatis of Jyeshtha.
phrasing_guidance: Describe tendencies, not fixed fate; the nakshatra is one factor among many (sign, house, aspects, dasha). Classical one-line Moon-nakshatra results are short lists of traits: present the positive ones as potentials and the negative ones as things to watch. Never state death, harm to relatives, or disease as a prediction. The Jyeshtha quarter and gandanta verses are traditional warnings about family members; never repeat them as predictions. If gandanta applies, say tradition recommends propitiatory rites for this birth portion, without fear-based language.

summary: Mula (0°00'-13°20' Sagittarius, ruled by Ketu, deity Nirriti) gives pride, wealth, steadiness and a drive to get to the root of things; its start is the Jyeshtha-Mula gandanta, and it carries strong traditional warnings for relatives.
common_outcomes: proud, wealthy, happy, not cruel, steady and fond of luxury (BJ 16.10)
wise, happy, rich, eldest among siblings, a ruler, but prone to disease and theft, and unsteady (HS 28.19)
gets to the root of things; relentless, impulsive, sometimes arrogant (Trivedi)
rare_outcomes: eloquent but dishonest, ungrateful and poor (JP 9.88, partly legible)
a seeker who can rise to power and later lose it (Trivedi)

by_area.personality: Proud and steady, fond of comfort (BJ); Trivedi: direct, sarcastic, bold and reserved, quick to drastic action; seeks the root and core of every matter.
by_area.career: Trivedi: medicine and healing, research (genetics, microbiology), investigation, law, military, public speaking.
by_area.finance: Wealthy (BJ 16.10; HS 28.19); Jataka Parijata's legible text says indigent; Trivedi: pada 3 is against money.
by_area.family: Eldest among siblings (HS 28.19). See padas for traditional warnings about parents.
by_area.spirituality: Trivedi: first of the nakshatras of the soul's spiritual journey; Jupiter's sign makes the transformation benign when well guided.

strengtheners: a well-placed Sun, Mars and Jupiter do well in Mula (Trivedi)
Jupiter's involvement steers Ketu's energy to good ends (Trivedi)
the person born in Abhukta-mula who survives raises the family and may lead an army (JP 9.64-67)
weakeners_or_cancellations: birth in the first portion (Abhukta-mula / gandanta) is treated as dangerous for the family (JP 9.45; HS 1.14; Saravali 3.20-21)
Ketu here often adds an extreme or idiosyncratic tinge (Trivedi)
lagna_or_context_notes: Gandanta: Mula opens the Scorpio-Sagittarius junction. JP 9.59: ganda at the start of Mula operates by day. Sun in Mula in the ascendant gives rulership of a small territory (Saravali 35.147).

attributes.deity: Nirriti, goddess of dissolution (Raman Muhurta; PVR; Trivedi); the Iyer table for BS 98.4-5 on wisdomlib shows Prajapati
attributes.symbol: a tied bunch of roots (Trivedi); Raman (HPA): six stars resembling a crouching lion
attributes.yoni: dog, male (Raman Muhurta); Trivedi also gives dog
attributes.nature: tikshna (sharp, dreadful) (BS 98.7; Raman Muhurta; Trivedi). Trivedi: active, tamasic, downward, neutral gender, butcher caste.
attributes.sign_span: 0°00'-13°20' Sagittarius; all 4 padas in Sagittarius; begins at the Scorpio-Sagittarius gandanta

as_moon: Varahamihira (BJ 16.10): proud, wealthy, happy, not cruel, steady and fond of luxury. Hora Sara (28.19): wise, happy and rich but prone to disease and theft, fortunate, unsteady, the eldest among siblings and a ruler. Jataka Parijata (9.88, OCR partly legible): eloquent but dishonest, ungrateful and indigent. Trivedi: relentless, impulsive and proud, seeking the root of things; capable of great power, which tends to be taken away at some point.
as_lagna: Trivedi: a prominent nose and ears and thick lower lip; not conventionally attractive but magnetic; arrogance, sarcasm and boldness in manner. His examples: Hanuman born with Mula rising; Ravana with his lagna lord (Sun) in Mula.
planets_in_it: the Sun in Mula (or Revati, Purva Phalguni, Uttara Phalguni) identical with the ascendant makes one head of a small country (Saravali 35.147)
the Moon in pada 1 is said to harm the father's wellbeing (Trivedi)
Jupiter-Ketu conjunction carries Mula's full energy (Trivedi)
a well-placed Sun, Mars and Jupiter do well; Ketu is strong but idiosyncratic (Trivedi)

padas.1: 0°00'-3°20' Sagittarius, Aries navamsha (Mars): deep searching; planets here, especially the Moon, said to harm the father (Trivedi). JP 9.51: birth in the 1st quarter endangers the father [maraka: text predicts danger to life / death]; JP 9.57 also says the first quarter of Mula costs the father.
padas.2: 3°20'-6°40' Sagittarius, Taurus navamsha (Venus): hardworking, creative; bad for the mother's wellbeing (Trivedi). JP 9.51: 2nd quarter endangers the mother [maraka: text predicts danger to life / death].
padas.3: 6°40'-10°00' Sagittarius, Gemini navamsha (Mercury): wordplay and communication; against money, afflicted planets can bring poverty (Trivedi). JP 9.51: 3rd quarter brings loss of wealth.
padas.4: 10°00'-13°20' Sagittarius, Cancer navamsha (Moon): most turbulent emotionally; ancient texts call it harmful and prescribe propitiation (Trivedi). JP 9.51: 4th quarter makes the native happy.
padas.fifteenths: JP 9.52-55 divide Mula into fifteen parts, each said to endanger a relative (father, paternal uncle, sister's husband, grandfather, mother, maternal aunt and uncle, and others), with the 12th part endangering the native [maraka: text predicts danger to life / death].

source_views.source: Prash Trivedi, The Book of Nakshatras, ch. 19 (Mula)
source_views.view: Gets to the root; relentless, impulsive, proud; can give and later take away power; Rakshasa, tamasic, sharp, active; dog yoni; pada notes including harm to father/mother; Jupiter-Ketu carries its energy.

disagreements: Deity: Raman, PVR and Trivedi give Nirriti; the Iyer translation's table of BS 98.4-5 (as rendered on wisdomlib) shows Prajapati, which looks like a table error but is recorded. Wealth: Brihat Jataka and Hora Sara say rich; Jataka Parijata's legible text says indigent. Pada 4: Jataka Parijata 9.51 calls it happy; Trivedi says ancient texts call it harmful and needing propitiation. Abhukta-mula: JP 9.45 places it at the Jyeshtha-Mula junction ghatika; the commentary note cites Lagnachandrika's first three ghatis of Mula.
phrasing_guidance: Describe tendencies, not fixed fate; the nakshatra is one factor among many (sign, house, aspects, dasha). Classical one-line Moon-nakshatra results are short lists of traits: present the positive ones as potentials and the negative ones as things to watch. Never state death, harm to relatives, or disease as a prediction. Mula is widely feared in Indian families; reassure that 'Mula dosha' verses are traditional cautions answered by shanti rites, and never say a parent or relative is at risk.

summary: Purva Ashadha (13°20'-26°40' Sagittarius, ruled by Venus, deity Apah the waters) gives pride, loyalty in friendship, a pleasing spouse and an optimistic, 'cannot lose' drive.
common_outcomes: a pleasing, devoted spouse; proud; steady in friendship (BJ 16.11)
firm friendships, modest, many sons, leads others, intelligent, enjoys good food and pleasure from the spouse, favoured by rulers (HS 28.20)
well-behaved, honourable, well off and calm (JP 9.88)
optimistic and undaunted by setbacks (Trivedi)
rare_outcomes: unrealistic aims, insensitivity to others (Trivedi)
little formal education; rising from hard circumstances (Trivedi)

by_area.personality: Proud yet modest and calm (BJ, HS, JP); Trivedi: invincible optimism, flamboyance and a love of life, with a habit of not learning from mistakes.
by_area.career: Trivedi: shipping, navy and water-related work, entertainment, motivational teaching, management, arts.
by_area.relationships: A pleasing, loving spouse and happiness through the spouse (BJ 16.11; HS 28.20); steady friendships.
by_area.family: Many sons (HS 28.20). See padas and planets for the Jataka Parijata warning about the father.
by_area.spirituality: Trivedi links it to the initiate of mystery schools and purification by the waters.

strengtheners: all planets except Saturn usually do well; Saturn is fine in padas 2-3 unless afflicted (Trivedi)
pada 3 is a Pushkara navamsha (Trivedi)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Moon in Purva Ashadha with Sagittarius rising endangers the father (JP 9.60) [maraka: text predicts danger to life / death]
acting without regard for consequences (Trivedi)
lagna_or_context_notes: JP 9.60 combines this nakshatra with a Sagittarius lagna; JP 9.64-67 give the risk period as the 9th month.

attributes.yoni: monkey, male (Raman Muhurta); Trivedi also gives monkey

Jataka Parijata (9.88): consistently well-behaved, honourable, well off and calm-minded. Trivedi: an optimistic conviction that it cannot lose; lives each moment fully and shrugs off hardship, though aims can be unrealistic.
as_lagna: Trivedi: a proud, serious face that breaks easily into laughter; flamboyant in dress and manner; keeps part of themselves secret.
planets_in_it: the Moon in Purva Ashadha with Sagittarius rising is said to cause the father's death (JP 9.60) [maraka: text predicts danger to life / death]
Venus reaches its highest individual energy here (Trivedi)
all planets except Saturn usually do well (Trivedi)

padas.2: 16°40'-20°00' Sagittarius, Virgo navamsha (Mercury): hard work towards great achievement; planets other than Venus help career (Trivedi).

padas.4: 23°20'-26°40' Sagittarius, Scorpio navamsha (Mars): secretive; occult wisdom or perversity; good for foreign affairs (Trivedi).

honourable, calm, happy, wealthy and learned (JP 9.89)
practical, responsible, respected for advice; finishes what it starts (Trivedi)
rare_outcomes: many enemies, distress, wandering and many wives, but kind and learned (HS 28.21)
rigidity and intolerance (Trivedi)

weakeners_or_cancellations: Jupiter is debilitated in the Capricorn part (Trivedi)
Mercury, Venus and Jupiter can make one too materialistic in the Capricorn part (Trivedi)
lagna_or_context_notes: Abhijit, the 28th nakshatra used in some muhurta and chakra work, is placed by Trivedi within the last part of Uttara Ashadha; PVR calls the last quarter of Uttara Ashadha Abhijit; Frawley places it between Shravana and Dhanishta.

Guru-Sani, Surya-Guru, Surya-Sani conjunctions carry Uttara Ashadha's energy (Trivedi)
Rahu, Mercury and Saturn are comfortable in pada 3, Saturn strongest; the Moon, Mars and Saturn handle pada 4 best (Trivedi)

common_outcomes: prosperous, graceful, learned in sacred knowledge, a noble spouse, well known (BJ 16.12)
learned in the Vedas, lives abroad, an exalted spouse, wealthy and famous (HS 28.22)
reveres Brahmins and gods, of the ruling class, rich and pious (JP 9.89)
skilled speaker and teacher; perseveres until things are finished (Trivedi)
